messages:
MarkH: Hey runtime — can someone pick up an onboarding bench for foxfire-13b-v1? Goal: p50 <= 18ms on H100 (80GB). Please run standard onboard suite for batch sizes 1,4,8 and seq lengths 64/128/512. Compare fp16 vs int8/qt (if available). Need perf logs, nsys profile, and notes about any kernel fallsbacks or OOMs. Would like results in ~today so we can decide canary.

Priya: I can run the smoke and full bench on staging-h100a later this afternoon. Which prompt set do you want? short chat-style or completion-style?

MarkH: Use the standard onboard_prompt_set (50 samples). Include both chat-style (seq 64/128) and long completions (seq 512). Also test with KV-cache warm and cold.

Evan: Quick FYI — foxfire changed rotary params compared to previous 13B variants; might affect kernel selection and cache layout. Add a run that forces the triton kernels flag so we can see perf delta. Also ping bench-bot when ready.

bench-bot: Scheduled bench job bf-190123 on staging-h100a (H100 80GB). Runs: fp16/int8, batch 1/4/8, seq 64/128/512, kv-cache warm/cold. ETA ~28m. Link: https://internal.redwood/jobs/bf-190123

Lisa: If int8 uses Triton kernels we sometimes hit memory pressure at batch8+seq512 — if you see OOM, drop batch to 4 and capture liveness dump.

bench-bot: bf-190123 results uploaded. Summary below and full logs+nsys at https://internal.redwood/jobs/bf-190123/logs

bench-bot: Results summary:
Model: foxfire-13b-v1
Hardware: H100-80GB (staging-h100a)
Configs & key metrics:
- fp16, batch=1, seq=64: p50=8.1ms, p95=16.7ms, tokens/s=210
- fp16, batch=1, seq=512: p50=16.8ms, p95=35.2ms, tokens/s=120
- fp16, batch=4, seq=512: p50=28.1ms, p95=65.3ms, tokens/s=480
- int8, batch=1, seq=64: p50=6.9ms, p95=14.8ms, tokens/s=240
- int8, batch=1, seq=512: p50=14.2ms, p95=31.0ms, tokens/s=140
- int8, batch=4, seq=512: p50=24.9ms, p95=58.7ms, tokens/s=540
Notes: KV-cache warm reduces p50 by ~3.8ms for batch=1 seq=512. No OOMs observed. Triton kernel path was used for int8 runs; observed slightly better throughput but higher p95 variance.

Evan: Nice — fp16 batch1 seq512 p50=16.8ms meets the <18ms target. int8 looks even better. Recommend canary to dedicated with max_batch=4, kv-cache enabled by default for pods serving chat workloads. Also add Triton flag to profiling notes.

Priya: I'll open a PR to add the foxfire-13b-v1 profile to the model catalog with the recommended config (fp16 fallback to int8, default max_batch=4, kv_cache=on for chat routes). Any objections to enabling prefill of kv-cache as a launch knob?

MarkH: Let's not prefill by default — it helps steady-state latency but hurts cold-start complexity. Add a note in the catalog about prefill tradeoffs. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :tada:

Lisa: Quick follow-up — I uploaded the nsys flame and a short trace showing the attention kernel hotpath: https://internal.redwood/jobs/bf-190123/nsys_flame.svg :white_check_mark:

bench-bot: Job bf-190123 closed. Artifacts: logs, traces, perf-summary.csv attached to job page.
